I am an old woman here in Mtwara, and this small plot is all I have. I cannot afford to buy fertilizer from the shop — the price is too high for me, and anyway I grow my maize together with cassava and maybe some cowpea, the way we have always done. I will use the seed I saved from last harvest, and I will weed with my hoe when the rains come. My children help me sometimes, but mostly it is my own two hands on this shamba.
